Nephrotic syndrome secondary to the diabetic nephropathy or chronic kidney disease\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2)Reasons for\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI) Azotemia : impaired renal excretion of urea and creatinine secondary to CKD.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EII) Anemia : decreased erythropoietin.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIII) Hypoalbunemia: capillary basement membrane and podocytes damage.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIV) \u0026nbsp;acidosis: acidification of urine is lost. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3) Rationale : syp potchlor was given because of the hypokalemia.. Inj. NaHCO3 was given because of metabolic acidosis ..Insulin and antihypertensives are given because known case of DM and HTN. Orofer XT was given because of anemia.. Inj. Lasix was given to decrease her volume overload. Spironolactone was given it was a potassium sparing diuretic.Calcium was given to the patient \u0026nbsp;because of hypocalcemia secondary to CKD. Indications of NaHCO3:metabolic acidosis in cardiac arrest, Tricyclic antidepressants, aspirin and phenobarbitone overdoses, Hyperkalemia, Crush injuries, C\/I \u0026nbsp;in certain conditions because of adverse reactions like Hypernatremia, metabolic alkalosis, cellulitis, seizures, Tetany, sodium retention, peripheral edema. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E4) indication of dialysis in this pt: worsening of SOB secondary to metabolic acidosis with Anuria not resolved with high ceiling diuretics.Crucial factor: pt became symptomatic on 3rd day \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E5) Causes of same condition : primary : Minimal change disease, Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, Membranous nephropathy. \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Secondary : DM, SLE, HIV , Viral hepatitis, malaria, amyloidosis, \u0026nbsp;Sarcoidosis, Drugs : Nsaids, gold, pencillamine Cancer: Hodgkin's and non Hodgkin's, solid tumours of GIT, RCC and lung.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E6)expected outcomes of ckd patients depend upon age,genes,associated co morbidities . He also gives history of pleural tapping done during his stay in the hospital.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThen 3 days back he had giddiness around 6pm while he was doing plaster work for walls ( which he does occasionally since 4 years). As he was not able to get up on his own, his son and the people around him have \u0026nbsp;taken him back home where he was found out to be having low blood pressure by RMP.
